about_the_game:
This Astral Pack includes 9 furniture items, 1 wallpaper, 1 flooring, 15 clothing items, and 5 wigs.

By the stars above, who is ready to guard the celestial skies! The Astral Pack has 28 space-themed outfits and furniture items available for you to customize your characters and decorate your homes, sheds, and farms.

Pack includes:
  • Astral Furniture Set: Astral Wallpaper, Astral Flooring, Astral Window, Astral Table, Cosmic Table, Astral Couch, Cosmic Couch, Astral Rug, Astral Staff, Cosmic Staff, Astral Lamp
  • Astral Trainee Outfit Set: Astral Trainee Wig, Astral Trainee Robes
  • Space Demon Outfit Set:Space Demon Ponytail Wig, Space Demon Shirt, Space Demon Pants, Space Demon Cape
  • Astral Knight Outfit Set: Astral Knight Helm, Astral Knight Gloves, Astral Knight Robes, Astral Knight Pants
  • Space Queen Outfit Set: Space Queen Wing, Space Queen Wings, Space Queen Dress
  • Space Princess Outfit Set: Space Princess Bow Wig, Space Princess Gown
  • Astral Demon Outfit Set: Astral Demon Wig, Astral Demon Shirt
